name: SEVERITY
description: Incident severity: P1 (critical), P2 (high), P3 (medium), P4 (low)

name: TEAM_OWNER
description: Team responsible for resolution: Platform, Data, Security, Infra

name: STATUS
description: Current status: Open, Resolved, In Progress

name: TIME_TO_DETECT_MINS
description: Minutes from incident start to detection

name: TIME_TO_RESOLVE_MINS
description: Minutes from detection to full resolution (null if unresolved)

name: ROOT_CAUSE
description: Root cause category: Deployment, Config, Infra, Third-party, Unknown

name: CUSTOMER_IMPACTED
description: True if the incident affected end customers

name: POSTMORTEM_DONE
description: True if a postmortem was completed
